author: Nubbies231
body: I don't know if this is a thing or not, but I think it would be cool if when people made an account on the forums and when they placed their birthday into it. It makes a little database for the server and that persons Birthday comes online it makes an Announcement little small one that just says "Happy Birthday to X, X, X, and X". Maybe give them like X amount of credits or something. Make it so they can't change their birthdate unless contacting a Forum Moderator and wabam solid.

replies.author: DaFrozenBlaze
replies.body:
Just like any other thing which lets you set your birthday, people don't set their real ones. It won't be pleasant to wish someone Happy Birthday with them saying that it isn't their birthday
There are people who put the date of the moon landing as their birthday for example when it's not actually their birthday
